goal: Ben (drawn young, about five years old) takes a tiny blue toy pan from the low shelf of the toy kitchen. No letters, words, or numbers anywhere.

Picture 3 shows the three toy pans: the SMALL RED pan (middle size), the TINY BLUE pan (the smallest; it fits inside the red pan), and the BIG YELLOW pan (the largest, about twice as wide as the red pan); each is a shallow round pan with one short straight handle. Keep the soft, round, bright 3D render look of the pictures, not a 2D drawing and no outlines. The children keep their chibi proportions: a big head and a small body. Hands are small, chubby child hands with five clear short fingers (four fingers and one thumb) when open, never fists unless stated, and a hanging hand shows relaxed, separate short fingers. Keep each character exactly as in the pictures: Ben: short messy light-brown hair, big brown eyes, a light-blue T-shirt, dark-blue shorts, grey sneakers. The picture: Ben takes the tiny blue toy pan from the low shelf. A medium shot at a low camera height in the play corner (picture 2). The low wooden shelf stands at the left with the small red pan and the big yellow pan still on it (picture 3). Ben stands in front of the shelf, reaches with one hand, takes the TINY BLUE pan by its handle, and lifts it a little; he looks at it with a proud smile. The toy kitchen is soft at the right.
